include_directories(
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/reactos/drivers/fltmgr
    includes)

# fltmgr export lib + .def (the Flt* API minifilters import) — kept; Rust provides the symbols.
spec2def(fltmgr.sys fltmgr.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# The 10 .c bodies replaced by Rust (fltmgr-rust). Filesystem Filter Manager.
# .c kept on disk (never-delete). Bar: link-clean x3.

# fltmgr.sys is all Rust (fltmgr-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/fltmgr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
add_cargo_module(fltmgr fltmgr-cargo fltmgr.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE fltmgr-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
